name: LinguaMark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate multilingual Visual Question Answering (VQA) capabilities of large multimodal models across 11 languages and five social attributes, measuring bias, answer relevancy, and faithfulness.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the multilingual VQA/fairness literature that is gaining attention mainly through the associated paper rather than broad leaderboard adoption.
notes: Focuses on multilingual fairness and bias in LMMs; includes evaluation on social attributes and releases benchmark and code for reproducibility.
